dialogues.jp: 「うう〜ん」
dialogues.en: "Uuuungh..."
dialogues.text: "Uuuungh..."

dialogues.jp: さわさわ……。
dialogues.en: *Chirp chirp*....
dialogues.text: *Chirp chirp*....

dialogues.jp: 「ふぁぁ……はぁ……ぁぁ……」
dialogues.en: "Fuwaaa...haaaaa..."
dialogues.text: "Fuwaaa...haaaaa..."

dialogues.jp:
身体を起こし、手を口にあてながら大きく口を
開く。
dialogues.en:
I rose from my bed, and covered my yawning mouth with my
hand.
dialogues.text:
I rose from my bed, and covered my yawning mouth with my
hand.

dialogues.jp: 「よし……起きるか」
dialogues.en: "Alright, better get up."
dialogues.text: "Alright, better get up."

dialogues.jp:
あまりぐずぐずしていると、朝飯の時間がなく
なる。むくりと起き上がり、着替えをすませ、
下に向かう。
dialogues.en:
I can't do things too slowly now, or I won't have time for
breakfast. I got up from bed, changed into my uniform, and
went downstairs.
dialogues.text:
I can't do things too slowly now, or I won't have time for
breakfast. I got up from bed, changed into my uniform, and
went downstairs.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「あ、朝倉せんぱーい」
dialogues.en: "Ahh, Asakura senpaaaai!"
dialogues.text: "Ahh, Asakura senpaaaai!"

dialogues.jp:
美春の声に校門の脇を見ると、片手をあげてい
る美春の姿が目にとまる。側には音夢もいる。
dialogues.en:
Looking to the side of the school gates, Miharu was waving
at me, with Nemu standing beside her.
dialogues.text:
Looking to the side of the school gates, Miharu was waving
at me, with Nemu standing beside her.

dialogues.jp: 「早いな美春」
dialogues.en: "You're early, Miharu."
dialogues.text: "You're early, Miharu."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「へへ、今日はひとつ前のバスに乗れたんです
　よ」
dialogues.en: "Hehe, I managed to take an earlier bus to school today!"
dialogues.text: "Hehe, I managed to take an earlier bus to school today!"

dialogues.jp: 元気に微笑む美春がブイサインをする。
dialogues.en: The energetic Miharu gave me a V sign.
dialogues.text: The energetic Miharu gave me a V sign.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「ちゃんと起きれたみたいですね、兄さん」
dialogues.en: "You managed to wake up early too, nii-san."
dialogues.text: "You managed to wake up early too, nii-san."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「まぁな」
dialogues.en: "I guess."
dialogues.text: "I guess."

dialogues.jp: 答えながら、微笑む音夢におでこをあわせる。
dialogues.en:
While answering her, I grinned and placed my forehead on
hers.
dialogues.text:
While answering her, I grinned and placed my forehead on
hers.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「ちょっと兄さん、なんですいきなり！？」
dialogues.en: "W, wait a minute nii-san! What are you doing?!"
dialogues.text: "W, wait a minute nii-san! What are you doing?!"

dialogues.jp:
慌てる音夢に構わず、カウントを心の中で数え
る。
dialogues.en: Ignoring her surprise, I continue counting in my head.
dialogues.text: Ignoring her surprise, I continue counting in my head.

dialogues.jp: 「熱はないみたいだな」
dialogues.en: "Alright, not hot there."
dialogues.text: "Alright, not hot there."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「もぅ……心配しなくても大丈夫ですから」
dialogues.en: "Geez... You don't need to worry so much, I'm fine."
dialogues.text: "Geez... You don't need to worry so much, I'm fine."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「だからって、あんま無理はするなよ」
dialogues.en: "Even so, don't push yourself too hard."
dialogues.text: "Even so, don't push yourself too hard."

dialogues.jp: 音夢からおでこを離し、ふたりと別れる。
dialogues.en: I finally seperate my forehead from hers.
dialogues.text: I finally seperate my forehead from hers.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉先輩、またあとで〜」
dialogues.en: "Asakura-senpai, see you later~"
dialogues.text: "Asakura-senpai, see you later~"

dialogues.jp:
後ろから聞こえる美春の声に、前を向いたまま
軽く手をふり、そのまま昇降口に向かう。
dialogues.en:
I waved my hand behind me after I heard Miharu's voice, as I
walked through the entrance.
dialogues.text:
I waved my hand behind me after I heard Miharu's voice, as I
walked through the entrance.

dialogues.jp: ◆校門前でコツン◆
dialogues.en: ◆Forehead-to-Forehead at the Schoolfront◆
dialogues.text: ◆Forehead-to-Forehead at the Schoolfront◆

dialogues.jp:
登校すると、音夢と美春に校門のところで会っ
た。音夢の体調確認のため、おでこを合わせて
熱をはかる。
dialogues.en:
On the way to school I saw Nemu and Miharu in front of the
school gates. I checked Nemu's condition by doing the
forehead test.
dialogues.text:
On the way to school I saw Nemu and Miharu in front of the
school gates. I checked Nemu's condition by doing the
forehead test.

dialogues.jp:
慌てる音夢を無視して、しっかりカウントをし
たのだった。
dialogues.en:
Ignoring the surprised Nemu, I calmly counted while feeling
the hotness of her forehead.
dialogues.text:
Ignoring the surprised Nemu, I calmly counted while feeling
the hotness of her forehead.
